requested_outcome: An invited VII administrator can understand and recover from a Google-account mismatch, while the correct invited account receives only its saved permissions.
authorization_boundary: Diagnose, implement, test and publish the requested administrator-login repair without changing the approved email or widening permissions.

lesson_bundle.reason: The failure is in an operational administrator access flow.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires persisted grant evidence, exact role boundaries, visible recovery guidance and a successful first-login contract test.

lesson_bundle.reason: Authentication is a shared high-risk family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires authorized, unauthorized, wrong-account, reload and existing customer-session regression checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: A generic unauthorized message is not an operational resolution.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires one clear current fact and one next action on the failure screen.

lesson_bundle.reason: The repair must work on the exact public release.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires one identified candidate, public route checks and a known rollback release.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Liran still sees only a generic unauthorized message.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Show the verified Google email selected for the failed admin attempt and tell the user to choose the invited account.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The forbidden admin screen visibly contains the selected account and the account-switch action.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The repair grants access to a different Google account.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep verified-email and Google-subject matching unchanged.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A mismatched email or subject remains denied in focused authorization tests.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The correct account loses its intended destination after retry.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve the requested admin return path through the failure and retry flow.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The layout redirects to login with a safe admin returnTo value.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The code passes locally but production still has the opaque message.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inspect the exact deployed admin login route after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public release contains the diagnostic copy and the live grant remains active and unbound until the correct account logs in.

affected_family: Google OAuth account selection and callback
administrator grant resolution and first identity binding
administrator users dashboard and audit trail
desktop and mobile administrator login states

sources.label: Live administrator grant and audit response

midpoint_gate.trigger: After focused source and authorization tests pass, before the production build.
checks: the failed login identifies the selected verified Google account
the retry stays in the administrator flow and preserves returnTo
email and subject mismatches remain denied

attack_questions: Can the message leak the invited administrator list to an arbitrary visitor?
Can a customer cookie appear as the failed administrator identity?
Can a wrong Google account gain access after seeing the diagnostic?
Does the exact public login route still show an unexplained generic failure?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: The exact public admin login and users routes on the deployed candidate.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused auth tests, full production build, live grant readback and desktop/mobile visual inspection.

effectiveness.baseline: Production stores Liran's active full-scope grant but shows only a generic unauthorized message; the grant audit has no identity_bound event.
effectiveness.target: A wrong-account attempt is self-diagnosing without weakening authorization, and the invited account path remains intact.
